_note: Runtime asset for Dio channel insertion. DioPortId and DioChannelId are derived from the pin's mscr value using the rules below. All values are grounded in Dio.xdm and the Uart_Example_S32K344 fixture.
dio_port_id_rule: DioPortId = mscr // 16  (integer division; maps mscr to the S32K3 GPIO port number)

dio_channel_id_range.uniqueness: DioChannelId must be unique within the DioPort (Dio.xdm constraint)

Name.description: Symbolic channel name provided by the caller (e.g. LED_CTRL).

DioChannelId.description: Port-relative channel index, 0-15. Computed as mscr % 16.

PDACSlot.source_ref: fixture/vendor-example: Uart_Example_S32K344 + example_Dio.mex (VIRTUAL_WRAPPER_PDAC0 is a valid Dio.xdm:DioConfig/DioPort/DioChannel/PDACSlot enum value; the default used here was confirmed from the vendor fixture, not from a Dio.xdm DEFAULT attribute)

Name.description: Port container name. Value is 'DioPort_<array_index>' where array_index is the zero-based position of this struct in the DioPort array.

DioPortId.description: S32K3 GPIO port number. Computed as mscr // 16. May differ from array_index when ports are non-contiguous.

DioChannel.description: Child array for DioChannel structs. Starts empty; channels are appended by the tool.

DioChannelGroup.description: Child array for DioChannelGroup structs. Empty for auto-created ports.

DioPortEcucPartitionRef.description: Child array for partition references. Empty for auto-created ports.

port_naming_rule: DioPort_<array_index>  (struct name attribute = array_index as string; Name setting = 'DioPort_' + str(array_index); DioPortId = mscr // 16, independent of array_index)
